HL7 FHIR specification and examples — license attribution
==========================================================

The HL7 FHIR specification (https://www.hl7.org/fhir/) and the resource examples
published within it are made available by Health Level Seven International (HL7)
under the Creative Commons "No Rights Reserved" (CC0 1.0 Universal) public-domain
dedication. See https://www.hl7.org/fhir/license.html and
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/.

This corpus does NOT redistribute any HL7 FHIR example file. Every instance under
testdata/fhir/ is a go-radx synthetic original, authored with entirely fictitious
data, that is merely *shaped after* the canonical resource structures the HL7 FHIR
R5 specification examples demonstrate. This notice attributes that shape reference.
